messages:
Maria L.: Hey team — handoff for the Infra Onramp Terraform samples and reference arch for the partner demo. Repo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-onramp-samples
Akash P.: thanks. is there a single terraform module we want partners to copy or a set of modules?
Maria L.: set. modules/0-bootstrap, modules/1-cluster, modules/2-deploy. keep opinionated defaults but allow overrides. see README in repo.
Jess S.: can you paste the minimal example we want partners to run? makes onboarding faster.
Maria L.: sure — minimal snippet in root README:
```hcl
module "redwood_onramp" {
  source = "git::https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra-onramp-samples//modules/1-cluster"
  region = var.region
  node_count = 3
}
```
Olivia K.: FYI legal asked about license header on the sample modules. please add Apache-2.0
Rade T.: will update docs and add a quickstart with `make demo`.
partner-engineer-aws: can we get a small CloudFormation wrapper for customers that can't use terraform? we can demo both.
Akash P.: we should instead provide an exported TF plan and a small script; less maintenance than CFN. OK to add `scripts/export-plan.sh`?
partner-engineer-aws: yes that works, thanks.
Jess S.: scheduling a 30m walk-through with partner-ops on Wed 10am PT. invite sent.
deploy-bot: CI passed for branch `infra/onramp-samples` — 7 checks ✅ https://ci.redwood-inference/internal/1234
Maria L.: next steps: (1) Rade adds Apache header + quickstart, (2) Akash adds export script, (3) Jess runs partner demo Wed, (4) partner-engineer-aws to confirm wrapper. tagging :shipit:
Rade T.: on it, will open a PR for docs + header today.
Akash P.: I'll add scripts/export-plan.sh and document it in examples/README.md
partner-engineer-aws: thanks all — will prep partner sandbox and share access by EOD Tue.
Maria L.: perfect. let's keep thread for follow-ups only. if blocker ping me directly.
